messages:
Jared: Quick follow-up from the PM writeup (memory eviction storm during batch rollout). Need concrete owners, Jiras, and a short RACI for follow-ups. I'll sketch suggestions below — pls ack and update by EOD.

Mei: Ack. Can we separate immediate mitigations vs. longer-term fixes? I'd like to own short-term mitigation.

Ravi: I can take the longer-term work around KV cache refactor and metrics. ETA: 3 weeks.

Mei: OK — RACI for the three items I propose: 1) short-term mitigation (auto-scale/bump thresholds) R=Mei, A=Jared, C=Ravi, I=QA Bot. 2) KV cache improvements R=Ravi, A=Jared, C=Mei, I=QA Bot. 3) CI/regression gating R=QA Bot, A=Jared, C=Mei, I=Ravi.

Jared: Created PM-2550 and linked new issues INF-4050 (short-mitigation), INF-4051 (kv-refactor), INF-4052 (regression-gate). Incident Bot linked them.

Incident Bot: Created INF-4050, INF-4051, INF-4052 and linked to PM-2550.

Mei: INF-4050 assigned to Mei. ETA 4 business days. I'll push a canary config and a rollback checklist.

Ravi: INF-4051 assigned to Ravi. I'll open a design doc and start a spike; ETA for spike: 7 days, full work ETA: 3 weeks.

QA Bot: INF-4052 assigned to QA Bot. Will add deterministic repros and a mandatory gating rule: regression tests must pass on staging for 48h before any merge into main.

Jared: Also proposing a ticket aging rule so owners don't drift. Draft Jira automation: 
```
when: issue created or updated
if: status != Done and days since created >= 5
then: comment "Owner review required: update ETA or escalate"; transition to "Needs Review"; notify #postmortems
```

Mei: Please add a label "recurring-pattern" to PM-2550 and INF-4050 so we can track cadence; this has happened ~3x in last 2 months.

Ravi: I'll add eviction-rate, kv-hit-rate and survivor-rate to the postmortem metrics dashboard and attach to INF-4051.

Mei: Hand-off plan for next 2 weeks: week1 primary = Mei (mitigations), week2 primary = Ravi (refactor follow-through). Jared will rotate in as fallback and approve acceptance criteria.

Jared: Final ask: update your tickets with owner, ETA, short acceptance criteria and any blocker notes by EOD tomorrow. If you need reassignments speak up now so I can reallocate. :white_check_mark:
